sentences.text:
Madhusudan Tantubay vs Unknown on 19 May, 2023
19.05.2023.

27. Ct.No.28 as (Allowed) C.R.M. (Db) 1933 of 2023 In Re:- An application for bail under Section
439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Indpur P. S. Case No.90 of 2022 dated
12.08.2022 under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and charge sheet submitted
under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code. .
In the matter of : Madhusudan Tantubay.
Mr. Arkaprabho Roy, Mr. Rhiddhiman Mukherjee, Mr. Udayan Mukherjee.

Mr. Tanmoy Kr. Ghosh, ld. Sga, Mr. Arindam Sen.
...for the State.
Heard the learned Advocates for the parties.
We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is suffering from heart ailments.
From the report, it appears petitioner is a patient of Rheumatic heart disease and was admitted in Bankura Sammilani Medical College and Hospital.

entities.text: Bankura Sammilani Medical College and Hospital
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid report which shows the poor health condition of the petitioner, purely on humanitarian consideration, we are inclined to release him on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner viz., Madhusudan Tantubay shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khatra, Bankura subject to condition that he shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khatra, Bankura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the event the petitioner fails to appear before the Trial Court without any justifiable cause, the trial Court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail in accordance with law without further reference to this Court.
The application for bail is, thus, disposed of.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Report is placed on record.
In view of the aforesaid report which shows the poor health condition of the petitioner, purely on humanitarian consideration, we are inclined to release him on bail.
Accordingly, the petitioner viz., Madhusudan Tantubay shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khatra, Bankura subject to condition that he shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
In the event the petitioner fails to appear before the Trial Court without any justifiable cause, the trial Court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail in accordance with law without further reference to this Court.
The application for bail is, thus, disposed of.
